questions.q: What is the capital of Djibouti?
questions.why: Most people live there.

questions.q: From which country did Djibouti gain independence in 1977?
questions.why: It was called French Somaliland.

questions.q: Which strait does Djibouti guard at the mouth of the Red Sea?
questions.why: It is a key shipping route.

questions.q: What is Djibouti's currency?
questions.why: It is pegged to the US dollar.

questions.q: Who has been President of Djibouti since 1999?
questions.why: He took over from his uncle.

questions.q: Which two languages are official in Djibouti?
questions.why: Somali and Afar are widely spoken.

questions.q: Which landlocked neighbour relies on Djibouti's port?
questions.why: A railway links Addis Ababa to Djibouti.

questions.q: Who was Djibouti's first President?
questions.why: He ruled until 1999.

questions.q: Which country has its only African military base in Djibouti, opened in 2017?
questions.why: The US and France also have bases there.

questions.q: Which US military base is in Djibouti?
questions.why: It is the only permanent US base in Africa.

questions.q: What was Djibouti called from 1967 to 1977?
questions.a: French Territory of the Afars and the Issas
questions.why: It named the two main groups.

questions.q: Which railway opened in 2018 linking Djibouti to Addis Ababa?
questions.why: China built it.

questions.q: Which civil war of 1991–94 involved Afar rebels?
questions.why: FRUD rebels fought the government.

questions.q: Which town was the first French colonial capital?
questions.why: France bought it in 1862.

questions.q: Which group of islands in the Gulf of Tadjoura is a marine park?
questions.why: They have coral reefs.

questions.q: Which salt lake is the lowest point in Africa?
questions.why: It is about 155 m below sea level.

questions.q: Which lake on the Ethiopian border has limestone chimneys?
questions.why: It looks like another planet.

questions.q: Which gentle giant fish visits the Gulf of Tadjoura each winter?
questions.why: Divers swim beside them.

questions.q: Which gulf cuts deep into Djibouti?
questions.why: It opens into the Gulf of Aden.

questions.q: What is Djibouti's climate like?
questions.why: It is one of the hottest places on Earth.

questions.q: Which leaf do many Djiboutians chew in the afternoon?
questions.why: It is a mild stimulant.

questions.q: Which sea lies to the east of Djibouti?
questions.a: Red Sea and Gulf of Aden
questions.why: It sits at their meeting point.

questions.q: Which forest in the Goda Mountains is a rare green area?
questions.why: It is home to the Djibouti francolin.

questions.q: Which rift zone in Djibouti is where Africa is slowly splitting?
questions.why: New ocean floor is forming.

questions.q: Which spicy dish of meat and rice is popular in Djibouti?
questions.why: It is often called the national dish.

questions.q: Which mountain range in the north holds Djibouti's highest point?
questions.why: It is on the triple border with Eritrea and Ethiopia.

questions.q: Which tall-masted Arab boats sailed from Djibouti's ports?
questions.why: They still carry goods.

questions.q: Which town on the Gulf of Tadjoura is the oldest in Djibouti?
questions.why: It is called the 'white city'.

questions.q: What are Djibouti's two main ethnic groups?
questions.why: Each makes up a large share.

questions.q: Which Djiboutian runner won the 1985 World Marathon Cup?
questions.why: He won Olympic bronze in 1988.
